Dramatic focus and entirely believable points of conflict make this slow-moving story grab hold for its full two hours.
While Touch will not be for everyone, it is an impressive document of the workings of the human heart.
Problems aside, “Touch” remains a quietly involving piece about the human heart and the ways people respond in times of grief.
